pages.description: Enjoy this adorable anime inspired Disney coloring sheet featuring Princess Rapunzel. Children can have fun coloring her long braided hair decorated with small blossoms, cute freckles, and a beautiful laced dress. Download this high quality printable activity for young artists who love fairy tales and sparkling details.
